sales.title: Multi-region sales performance
sales.summary: Revenue, margin and growth by region and category.
sales.objectives: Track sales performance and spot the regions and categories that create value.

epi.title: Weekly epidemiological surveillance
epi.summary: Incidence by zone, moving average, alert threshold and completeness.
epi.objectives: Quickly detect abnormal incidence rises and monitor report quality.

trial.title: Two-group comparison
trial.summary: Score change by group, mean difference and confidence interval.
trial.objectives: Compare the change in a score between control and intervention groups, with its uncertainty.
indicators: Sample sizes and loss to follow-up

budget.title: Programme budget tracking
budget.summary: Planned, actual, variance and execution rate by budget line.
budget.objectives: Visualise budget execution and spot lines drifting from plan.

sales.defRevenue: Revenue: sum of sales in US dollars over the selection.
sales.defMargin: Margin: revenue minus costs. Margin rate: margin divided by revenue.
sales.defAov: Average order value: revenue divided by the number of orders.

epi.defIncidence: Incidence: cases / population × 10,000. Moving average: mean of the last 4 weeks (minimum 2 observations).
epi.defThreshold: Alert threshold: mean + 2 standard deviations of the zone's incidence. Unreported weeks are never counted as zero cases.
epi.missingNote: {count, plural, =0 {All weeks are reported for this selection.} one {# unreported week in this selection (shown as a gap).} other {# unreported weeks in this selection (shown as gaps).}}

trial.defChange: Change: follow-up score minus baseline score. Complete-case analysis.
trial.defCi: 95% CI of the difference: Welch approximation (t distribution). Indicative result on synthetic data.
trial.lostNote: {count} participant(s) without a follow-up score are excluded from the means.

budget.byLineTitle: Planned and actual by line (executed months)
budget.defRate: Execution rate: actual / planned over executed months (January to September). Variance: actual − planned.
budget.defMissing: October to December have no actuals: they stay empty and do not count as zero.

about.title: About
about.lead: Data Analyst, Data Instructor and research consultant.
profile: My name is James Mvuye and I work under the LEARNMORE-DATA brand. I help companies, researchers and organisations turn their data into decisions through data analysis, visualisation and artificial intelligence.
I also teach digital mapping and spatial analysis with QGIS, and I support research work that needs a clear, documented statistical approach.

approach.title: Clarity
